desc: Build `pairs_at[b]` list of `a` values (with `a<b`) for each conflicting pair.
Sweep `i` from 1 to n, maintaining `max1` (largest `a` seen so far) and `max2` (second largest), compute `base += i - max1`, and accumulate `gain[max1] += max1 - max2`.
After sweep, compute prefix sums of `gain` from 1 to n-1, track maximum gain.
Return `base + max_gain`; test with provided examples.
